title: AIIMS NORCET 11th Nursing Officer Online Form 2026 – Start
organization: All India Institute of Medical Sciences
postName: Nursing Officer Recruitment Common Eligibility Test (NORCET) – 11
vacancyDetails: Nursing Officer posts in AIIMS and participating institutes through NORCET-11
qualification: B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing / B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing / Diploma in General Nursing & Midwifery with registration as per NORCET rules
ageLimit: As per NORCET-11 notification (typically up to 30 years with relaxations)
applicationFee: As per AIIMS NORCET fee structure
selectionProcess: NORCET CBT (Stage I / II as applicable) → Eligibility List → Institute allocation / DV
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.aiimsexams.ac.in
2. Open NORCET-11 online registration
3. Register with email and mobile
4. Fill form, upload documents, pay fee
5. Submit and print confirmation
shortDescription: AIIMS NORCET 11th Nursing Officer Online Form 2026 has started at aiimsexams.ac.in. Apply for Nursing Officer posts across AIIMS.
content:
AIIMS has started online registration for NORCET-11 (Nursing Officer Recruitment Common Eligibility Test).

Qualified candidates become eligible for Nursing Officer posts in AIIMS and other participating institutes as per seat matrix.

Apply only on aiimsexams.ac.in. Keep nursing registration certificate and educational documents ready.
